conflict|Iran.description: Grattan Institute report calls on government to ‘seize’ opportunity to cap diesel tax credits, introduce EV subsidies for less wealthy’ and build ‘clean’ refineriesGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastCapping lucrative diesel tax handouts to big business, building new “clean” refineries and targeting electric vehicle subsidies to less wealthy people could save Australians thousands of dollars in fuel per year, according to a major new report calling on the government to reduce reliance on imported fossil fuels.The Grattan Institute, one of the nation’s most respected thinktanks, has warned Australia imports too much of its fuel, and that the country must brace for more global supply shocks – like that from the war in Iran.
